title: Object Storage: resource count limit
content:
Object Storage resource count limit is defined as follows: Maximum provisioned resource count in one holding; integer.

| Contract tier | Resource count limit |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | resource count limit: 64 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | resource count limit: 64 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | resource count limit: 64 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | resource count limit: 64 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | resource count limit: 64 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | resource count limit: 64 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the resource count limit entry is 64.
